name: An 8164-Concept Two-Row Obstruction with Two Relative Failures
definition: From the same rectangular obstruction and $P'=\pi_0P$, $O'=\pi_0O$, take $C=(P'\times O)\cup(O'\times P)$, $D=(P'\times P)\cup(Q_5\times O)$, and $E=Q_5\times P$. Apply the nested-triple two-row construction.
parameters: The nested triple has orders $(|C|,|D|,|E|)=(892,1224,1344)$. The output has $8164$ concepts in dimension $14$, reduced input order $3480$, enlarged-row orders $2448$ and $2236$, and intersection order $2116$.
properties: The output is an ample pc-minimal obstruction. Neither enlarged row peels to their intersection: faces at old words $u=4$ and $v=9$ recover the certified relative obstruction $P\not\searrow O$. The reduction is the $3480$-concept forbidden input and has $18$ corners. Direct checks certify ampleness, both construction identities, positive input orders, and all $42$ elementary proper-minor orders.
